What You Need To Know Before Watching Avatar: Seven Havens (Explained By The Creators)
We caught up with Bryan Konietzk and Michael Dante, co-creators of Avatar and Sehaj Sethi, Ethan Spaulding, Executive Producers on Avatar Seven Havens! We got the low-down on the brand new Seven Havens series, and if it is friendly for a new audience who’ve never watched Last Airbender or Legend of Korra. We also asked the burning questions on how the Legend of Korra story played into this new series and who are the new Avatar’s and how they stack up against Aang and Korra! 

The first 3 episodes of Avatar: Seven Havens is out now on Paramount+!

author: IGN YouTube
text:
How GTA 5 Took Over the World
Over 230 million copies of Grand Theft Auto 5 exist worldwide. As the second-highest-selling game of all time, players worldwide have spent billions of hours on it, making it one of the most significant pastimes in the world. That’s an impressive achievement for what in 2013 was simply the highly anticipated next entry in Rockstar’s beloved (and notorious) open-world crime series. But GTA 5 proved to be much, much more than a typical sequel. It has become home to a huge, expressive, and loyal community that has made a digital hobby of everything from [warring alien clans](https://www.ign.com/articles/gta-online-alien-war-green-purple) to producing slick vehicle stunt movies. 

This is the story of how a video game became much more than a crime simulator. This is how GTA 5 took over the world.

Tekken 8 - Official Roger Jr. Gameplay Trailer (Ft. Yujiro Hanma Teaser)
Fresh from EVO France, we got the first look at everyone's favorite boxing Kangaroo, Roger Jr! Appearing for the first time since Tekken Tag Tournament 2, this feisty boxing duo excels at getting into their opponent's face and overwhelming them with offence and mixups! With some new tricky moves guaranteed to catch your opponents off guard, Roger Jr. is back and punchier than ever! 

We also got our first in-game look at Yujiro Hanma, the final DLC fighter of Season 3, with a gameplay trailer set for the Tekken World Tour Finals on January 17th 2027. 
You can get boxing with Roger Jr. when the duo step into the ring for Season Pass holders on November 12th! TEKKEN 8 is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam) and Xbox Series X|S.
